summary: dellemc.openmanage OME modules now fall back to OME_USERNAME/OME_PASSWORD and iDRAC/Redfish modules to IDRAC_USERNAME/IDRAC_PASSWORD environment variables; idrac_certificates supports CUSTOMCERTIFICATE, idrac_gather_facts supports secure boot, and idrac_license was added.
questions: Can I pass iDRAC credentials through environment variables?
What env vars do OME modules read for login?
Is there a module to manage iDRAC licenses?
Can idrac_certificates import a custom certificate?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage env var credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
- OME modules fall back to **`OME_USERNAME`** / **`OME_PASSWORD`**.
- iDRAC and Redfish modules fall back to **`IDRAC_USERNAME`** / **`IDRAC_PASSWORD`**.
- `idrac_certificates` imports/exports `CUSTOMCERTIFICATE`; `idrac_gather_facts` supports secure boot; new **`idrac_license`** module.
